material.acceptance_criteria: a CI check causes N rejected reloads in the browser, sees one stop line, and sees the last good data-mod-version kept.
material.description: The browser's rejected counter in watchMod is only reached when apply throws. CI never triggers it, because the server does not publish a version for a broken mod. Drive a reload the browser itself rejects (for example a map.bin the Game constructor refuses) and check the stop after MOD_MAX_FAILURES.
material.resolution: Test-only ?rejectReloads=N flag makes the next N applies throw before new Game. CI asserts five rejected applies, one stop line, data-mod-version held at 1, canvas present. Default path unchanged (flag absent means zero).
material.subject: Exercise the browser's rejected-reload counter in CI
